t: Anti-mould cleaner with bleaching effect. Easy-to-use spray formula for targeted use and reduced splashing. Removes mould, mildew, fungus and algae in damp places, and prevents re-growth. Can be used on grouting, seals, and plastered or tiled walls including marble. Ideal for use in areas such as kitchens, bathrooms, showers, swimming pools and saunas, as well as conservatories, gardens, sheds and outdoor furniture. Can also be used for cleaning facades, balconies, plant boxes and garden ornaments (excluding wood). Suitable for indoor and outdoor use. Bleaches mould and algae spots. Test in an inconspicuous place before applying.
